name: Vanguard
blurb: Holds the front of the line in plate. Takes the hits, keeps foes on you, and hits back hard.

name: Cutthroat
blurb: Strikes from the shadows and opens wounds that bleed. Stepping in the spilled blood drives them into a faster, harder Bloodlust.

name: Initiate
blurb: Strikes from afar with fire and frost, then shatters what is chilled. Fragile up close.

name: Ranger
blurb: Fights with the bow and keeps the foe at a distance. Every step away is safety.

name: Acolyte
blurb: Rots foes and drinks their life to mend. Spends their own blood when mana runs dry.
